We're rye-ly pleased to announce that we've just finished baking a brand new update for you. It's one that we crust you'll enjoy.

We've added a FRESH new control scheme called Gamepad Basic! This will make your bread a little easier to control, in case you were finding it too crustrating.

If you're in knead for a challenge though, we've kept the original controls, which are now called Gamepad Pro.

All NEW breads will automatically have Gamepad Basic by default and all EXISTING breads will have Gamepad Pro.

So, If you're an EXISTING bread and want something more doughable, you can switch to Gamepad Basic from the settings (as long as your Gamepad is plugged in and bready).

Alternatively, if you're a NEW piece of bread and looking for a challenge, you can switch to Gamepad Pro in the settings.

Lots of love,

The I am Bread Team

x o x o 

PS. I hope the puns haven't gotten stale ;)

notes.title: Dit soort aankondigingen wil je meer zien op Steam! Ben je er klaar voor? We hebben een GLOEDNIEUWE en GRATIS update voor iedereen die Surgeon Simulator: Anniversary Edition al bezit! Gaaf!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.bossastudios.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/Trump-gif-1.gif[/img]

Dit soort aankondigingen wil je meer zien op Steam! Ben je er klaar voor? We hebben een GLOEDNIEUWE en GRATIS update voor iedereen die Surgeon Simulator: Anniversary Edition al bezit! Gaaf! 

Heb je alleen Surgeon Simulator 2013? Geen probleem! De Anniversary Edition DLC is momenteel in de aanbieding, dus alle overige levels (ogen, tanden, DIT) aanschaffen kost slechts centen. Goedkoper kunnen we het niet maken!

Wat hebben we allemaal voor je in petto?

Donald Trump - hot or not? Wat je ook van hem vindt, je kunt hem niet negeren. Maar nu kun je wel op hem opereren! Geïnspireerd door het grootste politieke spektakel van het jaar vragen we je je stem uit te brengen in onze [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/317960/] GRATIS update voor Surgeon Simulator: Anniversary Edition[/url] op Steam. Maak je keuze: Donald Trump, schurk met een hart van steen, of held met een gouden hartje.

Met "Inside Donald Trump" stap je in de handschoenen van een meesterchirurg die vastberaden is Trumps leven te redden door zijn rammelende hart te vervangen - maar vervang je het door een hart van goud, of van steen? JIJ MAAKT DE KEUS! Er zijn tal van nieuwe, professionele operatiegereedschappen voor je beschikbaar; je kunt Donalds anesthesie aangenamer maken met Trump Vodka, hem strelen met een vlezige Trump Steak of zijn organen lospeuteren met de Trump Tower, plus een paar extra Trumpgerelateerde verrassingen (je hebt het zelf in de hand).

Hoeveel mensen Donald een gouden of stenen hart geven, wordt live bijgehouden door de ingenieuze graadmeter, de "swingometer", [url=http://www.surgeonsim.com/trump/]hier op de website [/url], net als tijdens echte verkiezingen.

Als dat je nog niet overtuigd heeft, bieden we ook een speciale make-upkit aan zodat je Trumps ware aard kunt laten stralen.

SAMEN MAKEN WE CHIRURGIE WEER GEWELDIG!

De allerliefste groetjes,

Het Surgeon Simulator-team 

x o x o

notes.title: WOOHOO - AN UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Don't get too excited, it's a PERFORMANCE update.

It's a pretty good performance update though, and everyone loves it when things run smoothly, don't they?

THE LIST:
[list]
 [*]There's now a much clearer settings menu - you'll be able to find out how to adjust your video options really easily now. WIN!
 [*]We've added a vSync option to the settings menu. If you don't know what this means, don't worry. If you do, we're sure you're smiling.
 [*]Some of you complained that [b]frame rate performance[/b] was poor for you since we left Early Access, especially in areas like the Petrol Station and Epilogue. We've made a number of improvements in these areas which should help you out a LOT if you've been experiencing problems in these areas.
 [*]Trading cards now working properly. START COLLECTING!
 [*]The Rampage mode interface now communicates combos better, so you have a better chance of working out how to max your score.
 [*]There's improved gamepad support, including rumble support. 
 [*]You may have noticed a flicker in the GIF recorder. That is now fixed.
 [*]Some of you found the bagel controls all sluggish and slow. Now they're as smooth and sleek as a racing unicorn.
 [*]We squished various little bugs here and there that are too yawn-some to list.
 [*]Gamepad support on the main menu has been improved.
 [*]You can now use LB and RB controller buttons to swap between game modes on the main menu calendar. Pretty cool...and useful!
 [*]Achievements are working more reliably now - no more frustration if you achieve.....then don't get your prize.
 [*]We've switched on leaderboards for later levels, so you can get your competitive butts ready for action throughout the whole game now.
 [*]We've rebalanced the Epilogue level - it was too tricky for most of you (and most of us).
[/list]

If you've found a bug or problem that we missed, please let Malford know on breadfeedback@bossastudios.com. He loves helping you, especially if you send him pictures of musical animals.

In closing, if you've ever wondered what the difference was between a bug and a feature, here's a handy diagram:

[img]http://www.bossastudios.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/bug-vs-feature.gif[/img]

Love you,

The I am Bread Team

notes.title: OUT OF THE TOASTER, IN TO FULL RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Hello Everybody,

Today is the day. I am Bread is fully baked and our latest gaming bun is out of the oven! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wk3byPNh2gA

This is the final update for the game which completes the adventure for our heroic little slice. It’s been a great ride with you all in Early Access and now the journey is complete. 

In the update today we have added:  

• New environment - Cell (Tutorial)
- All the basics you'll need to get your bread navigating the environments.

• New environment - Petrol Station
- Bread is out into the big wild world! Now, how to toast yourself in a petrol station? Any ideas? Can you guess….?

• New environment - Car (epilogue) 
- The final chapter to our story mode, is it the end, or the beginning?

• Magic Marmalade!
- Like regular marmalade but magic! Also, disables edibility and the grip limit so can progress through the game and not get super-frustrated and rage quit if you fail a few times and get stuck on a level.

• Revamped Rampage mode
- 153% better than the original Rampage mode, this revamp is smashtastic!
- There’s a new layout, and more stuff to smash. 

• Achievements
- Think the main game was hard? Wrong, the achievements are hard! 

• Trading cards
- Cards you can trade, yeh!

• Balancing
- Major rebalancing to make the game (even more) more awesome, and to make you laugh more, and cry less. Includes keyboard/joypad balancing -there’s much more grip on the keyboard now to bring it more in line with joypad play. Some modes unlock in a different order to reflect how difficult they are, so you don’t have to learn to run before you can walk.

• Bug fixes
- Numerous bug fixes. Nothing notable, just a few little things here and there that you reported to us.

Don’t forget, I am Bread has a week-long discount of 25% off the normal price (£9.99 / €12.99 / $12.99) so if you haven’t picked the game up yet, what are you waiting for? 

Many thanks,

The I am Bread Team
Master Bakers

notes.title: WE ARE BREADY FOR FULL RELEASE! :O
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

So, this is it. It’s been one helluva ride but we are very nearly at the end of the beginning… or is it the beginning of the end? Either way, what I am trying to say is that I am Bread will be leaving Early Access for its full release on Thursday 9th April!

We are incredibly excited that we have got to this point where we have one final update for the game (much more on this next week) that will complete the story and add all the bells and whistles you expect from a full game. You’ve seen a slice of the game and very soon you can play the WHOLE loaf! 

Thank you for being awesome during this, our first Early Access game. Your support, feedback and puns (mostly your puns) have been much appreciated during this ride. It’s been emotional and there will be more to come from this little heroic slice...

On launch day, I am Bread will be priced at £9.99 / €12.99 / $12.99 with a 25% discount for launch week. So you still have a week to pick the game up at it’s current Early Access price and then another week to get baking with a discount. Why wait, get baked today!

Meanwhile, in other news this actually happened at Rezzed 2015 in London:

[url=https://vine.co/u/1187388529739980800]BREAD MAN RISES[/url]

Ever yours,

The I am Bread team
Master Bakers

notes.title: GAME UPDATE - GARAGE and CHEESE HUNT and CRISPBREAD!
notes.notes:
Hey there bread lovers,

We’re really happy to tell  you that we have NEW STUFF to show you today. Today is a GOOD day!

[img]http://www.bossastudios.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/Upate3__10.jpg[/img]

Here’s what’s in store for you:
[list] 
[*]The Garage - a brand new level for you to explore and find novel ways to become golden brown.
[*]Lots of cool things to play with - a wheelbarrow, vacuum cleaner, chainsaw, football, garden rake, lawn mower and more!
[*]Cheese Hunt starring a new type of bread - Crispbread!
[*]We’ve improved the keyboard controls, because a lot of people asked (begged) us to. You’re welcome. ;)
[*]The grip meter has been adjusted - you now have longer lasting grip. This was one of our biggest requests from our bread community - hope you find the game more fun now it’s been changed.
[*]There’s now a heat haze on  heat sources,  so you can better identify the things that will help you in your quest to become toast.
[*]Lighting has been improved to make the game prettier and shinier.
[*]Various bugs have been fixed, such as the zero G bug. There’s also better physics stability.
 [/list]
We’re working hard on the NEXT update now. If you’d like to see what we’re doing before anyone else, make sure you follow the I am Bread Facebook and Twitter.  

https://www.facebook.com/IamBreadGame
https://twitter.com/IAmBreadGame

[b]Stay toasty, 
I am Bread Team // Bossa Studios[/b]

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z04vAAr2Pis
Thank you for joining us through Early Access to help shape this game into the beautiful piece of toast we all know it will become! 

We've really appreciated all of the feedback, suggestions, videos and artwork that you've been sharing with us so far and can't wait to see what else you come up with! 

Today is good day to be Bread - We're excited to announce our first update! 

[h1]New features and improvements:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Camera sensitivity slider added
[*]More sound effects on objects
[*]Music is no longer positional
[*]Mouse pointer is now only displayed in menus when using controller
[*]Lights now toast the bread
[*]Rocket now toasts the bread 
[*]Oven now toasts the bread
[*]Glasses and bottles are now breakable
[*]The ants are faster (more obviously hazardous)
[*]Keyboard is now configurable
[*]Controller improved for UI 
[*]Improved toasting feedback
[*]Grading rebalanced to be fairer
[*]Jam less sticky, to avoid getting completely stuck
[*]Jpg and GIF sharing now working
[*]UI improvements
[*]Improved lighting for high visual quality settings
[*]Various bugs fixed
[*]Adjusted the grip meter
[/list]

If you want to join us on facebook, twitter or in the steam forums, we're always bready for a conversation and would love to hear your feedback and thoughts!

We're also pleased to announce the launch of Bread Dairies, our new video series discussing updates, community news and all things Bread. 

[b]Stay toasty,[/b]
I am Bread Team // Bossa Studios
